d: NDRF IG Narendra Singh Bundela briefed the media on the impact and ongoing response operations following the landfall of cyclone Arnab. He said Cyclone Arnab has weakened from a very severe to a severe cyclonic storm after making landfall. It is expected to weaken further into a cyclonic storm by noon and a deep depression by evening. Northern Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha have been the worst affected, with strong winds and heavy rainfall reported in several districts.
